title: Establish the consumer contract before writing a failing regression
applies_when: A candidate alleges a formatting, validation, shape, resource-budget or backend-support mismatch from a helper name, comment or partial source window, and proposes expected behavior without tracing the producer and consumer.
lesson: Trace the producer, allocation, transformations and consumer before inventing expected behavior. Later assignments may overwrite suspicious registry values. Distinguish instance labels from hostnames, captured token capacity from request count, and registered kernel geometry from excluded examples. Inconsistent fabricated metadata is not a reachable defect; shape/dtype acceptance alone does not admit empty or sentinel-only input. Inspect downstream edge counts and work geometry. Missing validation does not prove an invariant, and changing a device assertion does not establish backend support. Intersect a fallback trigger with native launch constraints before allocating a huge reproduction. Require a supported caller and observable native failure before environment repair or publication; the cited counterexamples retain their specific contracts and limits.
avoid_when: Reachable malformed inputs, escaping/length violations or supported shape mutations can be real defects. An empty shape denotes a rank-zero scalar, not zero storage: its one element still contributes dtype bits and vector lanes to view-size checks. Partial initialization may satisfy fragment-only consumers but fail a later full-tensor overflow check: inspect every reader and cross-step buffer reuse, not only the norm or optimizer copy. Establish temporal corruption through a genuine prior operation and a finite public training step; arbitrary scratch poisoning is not reachability proof. Error wording may have its own documented API contract. Callback stand-ins must preserve backend transformations: RoPE+SDPA may return BHSD from BSHD even when plain SDPA preserves shape. Baseline-fail/patch-pass against an invented callback is insufficient. Static review falsifies a specific claim; it does not prove native or general correctness. External or dynamic callers may remain unobserved.

evidence.note: Submitted correction with a public DP2 Engine regression: real NaN step then finite steps, all parameters active, BF16/FP16 master variants and FP32 controls. The PR reports old-version finite-update failures and four patched passes on B300. Review/CI acceptance, convergence and performance are not established; the wider no-offload comparison was environment-blocked.

Low-precision offload restoration copies only the owned fragment into reused scratch and clones a full parameter-sized view. Fragment-only readers alone do not prove a defect; the separate full-gradient overflow reader and reset lifetime make the submitted temporal regression meaningful.
Expert registration overwrites dense entries for matching mesh dimensions. Missing dimensions can retain a dense entry but do not prove a supported training failure.
The HSDP adapter constructs matching dense/expert dimension names. A mismatched-mesh regression needs a separate supported caller, not this producer.
All-invalid q2k can divide by zero; shipped builders require full edges and fixed geometry. A zero guard is not empty-route support; the standalone diagnostic contract remains open.

The small-token guard precedes a fallback requiring >2046 MiB. Ordering alone is not a supported-input failure; combine it with native launch constraints rather than lowering MAX_COMM_SIZE artificially.

16-byte accesses, <=8-block clusters and <=1024 threads limit supported ranks 2/4/8/16 with token_num<=world_size to <=32 MiB, below the fallback threshold. This refutes the hang hypothesis, not collective correctness or malformed-input diagnostics.

CLI choices reach argparse; choices.py exposes plugin registration. Enum CUSTOM fallback alone does not prove typo acceptance. Programmatic consumers need separate evidence; not a server or GPU qualification.
DNS-SD instance labels permit non-control punctuation and are limited to 63 octets; this is a protocol requirement, not a measured application result.
The standard explicitly distinguishes service instance names from hostnames and their naming restrictions.
One normalizer feeds host labels and service instances. A trailing hyphen in the latter alone does not prove an invalid zone; overrides and resolver behavior need separate evidence.
Capture sets metadata_rows=num_tokens; replay derives num_rows from captured sequence_lengths.numel(). This refutes the request-count claim for initialized capture, not GPU correctness.
The comment excludes B_K=128 variants; registry ids 1400-1404 and 6400-6404 use B_K=64. Asserting their removal does not demonstrate a comment contradiction.
Padded A/B formulas give 66-148.5 KiB for registered B_K=64 (<160 KiB); excluded B_K=128 gives 165/231 KiB. Source arithmetic, not compiled HIP or GPU correctness.

Raw-verify leaves extend_seq_lens=None. Its consumer uses full_like, then torch.minimum creates a new tensor before clamp_min_. Fabricated non-None fields do not prove corruption here; other setters remain unverified and Tensor.to alone need not copy.
The constructor assigns lower_bound; later getattr/direct reads do not prove it missing here. Fabricated objects are not supported-path evidence. Source falsification, not GPU/all-model correctness.
